baseline.differences_from_public: Repository documentation/benchmark scaffolding and ARM portability guard in htslib/Makefile only; no StringTie algorithm-source changes. Runtime linked to the same dependency archives as candidate.
baseline.serial_compatibility_patch: In rlink.cpp after extern GFastMutex printCovMutex: #ifdef NOTHREADS; GFastMutex printCovMutex; #endif. Same definition also in candidate. This resolves two existing output lock references and creates no thread.

candidate.source_delivery: Optimization source is included in the same Git commit as this report; compare against base_commit.
candidate.publication_whitespace_note: A single trailing blank line was removed from read_pair_index.h and scripts/benchmark_serial.py for publication. source_sha256 records the measured snapshot before this nonfunctional cleanup.

build.build_parallelism: -j4 is used only for compilation, never for benchmark execution
build.objects: gclib/GBase.o gclib/GArgs.o gclib/GStr.o gclib/GSam.o gclib/gdna.o gclib/codons.o gclib/GFastaIndex.o gclib/GFaSeqGet.o gclib/gff.o bundle.o rlink.o tablemaker.o tmerge.o stringtie.o
build.library_note: Both final executables were relinked from their respective serial object files against these byte-identical static archives, rather than merely libraries of the same version.

validation.timing_environment: Sequential runs on same Apple M1 Max; no agent compilations or other benchmark jobs overlapped final measured runs. No profiling during timing.
validation.thread_verification: Source-audited NOTHREADS builds plus separate sampled probes. No observed additional threads; source contains no requested HTS/BGZF worker initialization in this mode.
validation.limitations: Synthetic tiled short-read benchmark; not universal or long-read 2x proof. OS thread samples are not continuous resource enforcement.

publication_note: Local absolute paths were replaced with repository-relative paths for publication. Measurements, binary/input hashes and observations are unchanged. Generated GTF/log files and binaries are not included.
